irac.issue: Whether the Wakf Board can be considered as an authority under Section 29-A of the Wakf Act, 1995 for the purpose of determining the Wakf properties.
irac.rule: The Wakf Board is an authority under Section 29-A of the Wakf Act, 1995 and is empowered to determine the Wakf properties.
irac.application: The court applied the principles of statutory interpretation to Section 29-A of the Wakf Act, 1995 and held that the Wakf Board has the authority to determine Wakf properties.
irac.conclusion: The Supreme Court held that the Wakf Board has the authority to determine Wakf properties under Section 29-A of the Wakf Act, 1995.
